question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Alas! The forest turned into a ______ land.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Bare'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is**: bare**
 
• The word **"bare"** means naked, uncovered, or devoid of the usual furnishings.
